name: Dumbbell shoulder press
notes: Seated or standing dumbbell overhead press. Record the load of one dumbbell.

guide.setup: Hold dumbbells at shoulder level with forearms near vertical and ribs stacked over the hips.
guide.execution: Press overhead until the arms are straight, then lower the dumbbells with control to shoulder height.
guide.cues: Keep ribs down. Press up and slightly in. Keep the head neutral.
guide.mistakes: Arching the lower back; flaring elbows excessively; dropping too quickly; forcing painful range.
